pathways.subtitle: The right visa depends on how much experience you have right now. Select your situation below.

panels.label: Under 1 Year Exp
panels.title: You're 1 Year Away From 482 Eligibility
panels.subtitle: You don't qualify for a 482 visa yet, and any agency that suggests otherwise is misleading you. The good news: one year of genuine, verifiable Australian work experience changes everything. That's exactly what our Career Launch Program is built to produce.

leftItems.title: 1 year paid full-time experience
leftItems.desc: In an occupation on the MLTSSL or STSOL

leftItems.title: Verifiable employment records
leftItems.desc: Payslips, contract, reference letter - all documented

leftItems.title: Employer willing to sponsor
leftItems.desc: RedBridge connects you once experience is in place

rightItems.title: Enrol in Career Launch
rightItems.desc: Gain 12 months of paid, structured work with our partner employers

rightItems.title: Skills assessment (occupation-dependent)
rightItems.desc: ACS (ICT) or AMI (Marketing) is not mandatory for all 482 occupations, but strongly recommended for 186 DE and Career Launch clients. Your consultant confirms if required.

rightItems.title: Match to 482 sponsor
rightItems.desc: We transition you directly from Career Launch into employer sponsorship

panels.note: Honest note: This is a longer path, but it's the right one. We would rather tell you this now and build your case properly than take your money for a visa you won't receive.

panels.label: 1-3 Years Exp (482)
panels.title: Work in Australia With a Verified Employer Sponsor
panels.subtitle: You have the experience. What you need now is an employer who holds current 482 sponsorship approval and is genuinely looking to fill a role in your occupation. That's what our network provides, and it's verified before we introduce you.

leftItems.title: Occupation on the CSOL
leftItems.desc: Core Skills Occupation List (replaced MLTSSL/STSOL from December 2024) - 456 eligible occupations

leftItems.title: Salary meets TSMIT
leftItems.desc: Temporary Skilled Migration Income Threshold - reviewed annually by the government

leftItems.title: English proficiency
leftItems.desc: IELTS, PTE, or TOEFL - minimum scores vary by occupation stream

leftItems.title: Approved employer sponsor
leftItems.desc: Your employer must hold current sponsorship approval from the Department

leftItems.title: Skills assessment - occupation-specific
leftItems.desc: Mandatory for only a small group of occupations, primarily trade roles. Most ICT and Marketing occupations do not require mandatory skills assessment for the 482 visa.

rightItems.title: 186 Transition Stream (TRT)
rightItems.desc: After 2 years with your 482 sponsor in an occupation on the CSOL, you can apply for Permanent Residency

rightItems.title: Regional option - 494 visa
rightItems.desc: If your employer is regional, the 494 pathway leads to 191 PR after 3 years

rightItems.title: Points-tested migration
rightItems.desc: Some clients transition to 189/190 if points-eligibility is established during employment

panels.note: Important: The SAF levy, nomination fees, and visa application charges are paid by your sponsoring employer, not you. RedBridge's fees cover placement and program support only.

panels.label: 3+ Years Exp (186 Direct)
panels.title: Skip the Temporary Stage. Apply Directly for Permanent Residency.
panels.subtitle: With 3 or more years of relevant experience and a skills assessment, you may qualify to bypass the 482 stage entirely and lodge a 186 Direct Entry application, moving straight to Permanent Resident status if the nomination is approved.

leftItems.title: 3 years relevant work experience
leftItems.desc: In your nominated occupation - well-documented and verifiable

leftItems.title: Positive skills assessment - mandatory for 186 DE
leftItems.desc: Unlike the 482 visa where assessment is occupation-specific, skills assessment is required for the 186 Direct Entry stream.

leftItems.title: Approved employer sponsor
leftItems.desc: Must nominate you for a genuine full-time position at market salary

leftItems.title: Under 45 years of age
leftItems.desc: Age requirement applies at the time of application lodgement

leftItems.title: English proficiency
leftItems.desc: Competent English required - vocational English in some circumstances

rightItems.title: Permanent Residency from day one
rightItems.desc: No temporary visa stage - you become a PR upon grant

rightItems.title: Full work rights
rightItems.desc: Not tied to a single employer after grant - work anywhere in Australia

rightItems.title: Immediate Medicare access
rightItems.desc: Full access to Australia's public health system from grant date

rightItems.title: Pathway to citizenship
rightItems.desc: You may apply for Australian citizenship when you become eligible under the residency rules in force at that time

panels.note: Note: Direct Entry requires a skills assessment, which can add 2-4 months to your overall timeline. We begin this process in parallel with employer matching to minimise delays.
